build_PointCloudOptimizer: build a PointCloudOptimizer instance to optimize a global scene from pairwise image observations with camera poses and depthmaps
create_PresetPose_optimizer: create a PointCloudOptimizer and preset known camera poses using preset_pose to fix them during optimization
test_forward_optimizer: test the PointCloudOptimizer forward method to compute the alignment loss between projected 3D points and pairwise predictions
refactor_ParameterStack: refactor the ParameterStack helper to stack and optionally pad a list of torch parameters into a single tensor
review_depth_to_pts3d: review the PointCloudOptimizer depth_to_pts3d method that converts depthmaps to 3D points using camera intrinsics and poses
